entities.name: Gudul delta
entities.description: Expansive region in southern Tarkir containing the bulk of the Sultai Brood's domain.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A clan whose domain lies in the Gudul delta, once controlled by the Silumgar brood.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the Gudul delta lies.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: An ancient dragon who ruled the Sultai, using Marang River Fortress as his seat of power.

entities.name: Kotis
entities.description: Led a resistance from Kishla Village against Silumgar.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker whose actions altered Tarkir's timeline.

entities.name: Kheru City
entities.description: The central city of the Sultai, built around the Kheru temple complex.

entities.name: Ukud Necropolis
entities.description: Resting place of Silumgar's high-ranking dragons' bones and a vault for his treasures.

entities.name: Marang River Fortress
entities.description: Fortress near a steep pass; seat of Silumgar's power.

entities.name: Kishla Village
entities.description: A small fishing village on stilts in the swamps.

entities.name: Bloomvine Jungle
entities.description: The largest contiguous jungle of Sultai territory.

entities.name: Sagu Forest
entities.description: Vast jungle at the edge of Sultai territory, ancestral home of the naga.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A ritual after which Silumgar disappeared.

events.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai begin raiding the Ukud Necropolis vaults.
events.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai began raiding its vaults.

events.summary: Kotis leads a resistance from Kishla, briefly independent from Silumgar until reinforcements push rebels into the jungle.
events.quote: the village was briefly independent from Silumgar

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol alters Tarkir's timeline, erasing the original history of these locations.
events.quote: The history outlined below was erased by Sarkhan's actions.
